senses.en: the season between winter and summer
a coiled piece of metal that stretches or compresses
a place where water flows naturally out of the ground

ex.en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
Warmer temperatures in spring can cause plants to flower earlier, affecting insects that depend on them.

tip: Trước tên mùa thường dùng in; nghĩa “suối” và “lò xo” đều là danh từ đếm được.

senses.en: The capital city of Italy

ex.en: We spent our first afternoon in Rome exploring ancient ruins.
Cities such as Rome must balance the economic benefits of tourism with the protection of historic sites.

col: the city of Rome｜thành phố Rôma
a trip to Rome｜chuyến đi Rôma
tip: Tên thành phố viết hoa chữ cái đầu, phía trước thường không dùng the.

senses.en: A group of musicians who perform together.
A narrow strip or ring of material or colour.
A range of frequencies, values, or levels within a system.

ex.en: My sister plays the drums in a local band.
Live bands at community festivals can attract visitors and create opportunities for local businesses.

tip: Trong IELTS, band chỉ mức điểm, không phải ban nhạc.

senses.en: the direction where the sun rises, opposite west
in the east or facing towards it

senses.zh: về phía đông; ở phía đông
senses.en: towards or in the east

ex.en: Our kitchen window faces east and catches the morning sun.
Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the east of the country.

tip: in the east of chỉ phần phía đông bên trong; east of chỉ nơi nằm ở phía đông của một nơi khác.

senses.en: A long curved fruit with soft flesh and usually yellow skin

ex.en: He peeled a banana and sliced it over his cereal.
Banana farming provides an important source of income for many families in tropical regions.

col: a bunch of bananas｜một nải chuối
tip: Danh từ đếm được: một quả chuối là a banana.

senses.en: A device used to take photographs or record moving images.

ex.en: She raised her camera to photograph the sleeping cat.
Installing a camera at each entrance may improve security, but residents have raised concerns about privacy.

col: a digital camera｜máy ảnh kỹ thuật số
a camera lens｜ống kính máy ảnh
tip: camera có thể là máy ảnh hoặc máy quay, tùy ngữ cảnh.

senses.en: A list of food and drinks available to order

senses.zh: menu máy tính; danh sách lựa chọn
senses.en: A list of choices available on a computer or device

ex.en: There are several vegetarian dishes on the menu.
Displaying nutritional information on a restaurant menu may help customers make healthier choices when eating out.

tip: Nói món có trong thực đơn dùng on the menu, không dùng in.

senses.en: A female child or young woman

ex.en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.

tip: Phụ nữ trưởng thành gọi trang trọng là woman; girl không trực tiếp có nghĩa là bạn gái.

senses.zh: câu trả lời; đáp án; giải pháp
senses.en: a reply, correct result, or solution to a problem

senses.zh: trả lời; đáp lại; nghe (điện thoại)
senses.en: to reply to someone or respond to a call

ex.en: I asked the price, but nobody gave an answer.
Improving public transport may provide an answer to traffic congestion in rapidly growing urban areas.

col: answer a question｜trả lời câu hỏi
the answer to a problem｜giải pháp cho vấn đề
a clear answer｜câu trả lời rõ ràng
tip: Động từ answer đi thẳng với câu hỏi; danh từ dùng the answer to.

senses.en: a long, thin mark on a surface
people or things arranged one behind or beside another
a route or connection for transport or communication

ex.en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
Extending the railway line could connect rural communities with employment opportunities in nearby cities.

tip: Xếp hàng trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ hay dùng stand in line, tiếng Anh-Anh hay dùng queue.

senses.en: A title used before a man's surname or full name

ex.en: The children greeted their new neighbour as Mister Green.
In formal interviews, candidates may address a male interviewer as Mister followed by his surname.

tip: Thường viết là Mr (Mỹ viết Mr.), đọc là Mister, theo sau là họ.

senses.en: A movable barrier used to open or close an entrance.

ex.en: Please close the door before the cat gets out.
Installing wider doors in public buildings can make everyday journeys easier for people who use wheelchairs.

tip: at the door là ở cửa; answer the door là ra mở cửa khi có người gõ.

senses.en: To raise the corners of your mouth, showing happiness or friendliness.
A facial expression with raised mouth corners, often showing happiness.

ex.en: The baby smiled when I waved across the room.
A friendly smile can help patients feel more comfortable when discussing their concerns with healthcare professionals.

col: smile at someone｜mỉm cười với ai
a warm smile｜nụ cười ấm áp
a broad smile｜nụ cười rạng rỡ
tip: Cười với ai dùng smile at, không dùng smile to.

senses.en: The tenth month of the year, between September and November.

ex.en: Our local swimming pool will open again in October.
The university begins its annual community research programme in October, giving students opportunities to investigate local environmental issues.

tip: Tên tháng viết hoa chữ cái đầu; trước tháng dùng in, trước ngày cụ thể dùng on.

senses.en: A part of a building separated by walls and doors.
Available space or opportunity for something.

ex.en: My room has a desk beside the window.
Although public transport has improved significantly, there is still room for further investment in rural services.

col: room for improvement｜chỗ để cải thiện
tip: Nghĩa căn phòng là đếm được; nghĩa không gian hoặc chỗ trống là không đếm được.

senses.en: a period of relaxing without working or being active
to relax or allow someone or something to recover

senses.zh: phần còn lại; những người còn lại
senses.en: the people or things that remain

ex.en: Let's have a rest under that shady tree.
Regular periods of rest can help employees maintain concentration and reduce the risk of workplace accidents.

tip: the rest of cộng danh từ; động từ chia số ít hay số nhiều tùy danh từ được nhắc đến.

senses.zh: cô; dì; mợ; thím; bác gái
senses.en: Your parent's sister, or the wife of your parent's sibling.

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to bake bread.
Extended family members, such as aunts and uncles, often provide valuable childcare support for working parents.

col: aunt and uncle｜họ hàng như cô, dì, chú, bác
tip: Không phân biệt bên nội hay bên ngoại; trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ cũng hay đọc /ɑːnt/.

senses.en: To look at something attentively for a period of time.
A small clock worn on the wrist or carried.
To take care of someone or look for possible danger.

ex.en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.

tip: watch nhấn mạnh việc xem liên tục; see nhấn mạnh kết quả là nhìn thấy.

senses.zh: thú vị; hào hứng; kích thích
senses.en: Making someone feel eager, enthusiastic, or thrilled.

ex.en: The final minutes of the match were incredibly exciting.
Advances in renewable energy offer exciting opportunities for young engineers seeking to address global environmental challenges.

col: exciting opportunity｜cơ hội đầy hứng khởi
exciting development｜bước phát triển đáng phấn khởi
exciting experience｜trải nghiệm đầy kích thích
tip: exciting miêu tả sự vật gây hứng thú; excited miêu tả cảm xúc của người.

senses.en: The continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic and Indian oceans.

ex.en: My cousin returned from Africa with beautiful handmade baskets.
Investment in renewable energy across Africa could expand electricity access while supporting sustainable economic development.

tip: Tên châu viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không dùng mạo từ; châu Phi không phải là một quốc gia.

senses.en: on certain occasions, but not always or regularly

ex.en: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
Working from home sometimes improves productivity, although its benefits depend on suitable equipment and a quiet environment.

tip: sometimes là đôi khi; some time là một khoảng thời gian.

senses.en: A publication containing news, articles, and advertisements, usually printed daily.
An organization that produces and publishes news in a newspaper.

ex.en: My grandfather reads the newspaper while eating breakfast.
Local newspapers provide valuable coverage of community issues that national media may overlook.

tip: Một tờ báo dùng a newspaper; khi là vật liệu gói đồ thì có thể không đếm được.

senses.en: Good, satisfactory, healthy, or of high quality.
Made of very small particles or having little thickness.
Money that must be paid as punishment for breaking rules.

ex.en: I feel fine now, so let's go for a walk.
A substantial fine may discourage companies from dumping industrial waste into rivers and damaging local ecosystems.

tip: fine cũng là động từ chỉ việc phạt tiền: fine sb for sth.

senses.en: a vessel for travelling on water, usually smaller than a ship

ex.en: We hired a small boat and explored the lake.
In remote coastal communities, travelling by boat remains essential for accessing schools and medical services.

tip: by boat không có mạo từ; on a boat nghĩa là ở trên thuyền.

senses.en: A small stiff rectangle used for payment, identification, or information.
A decorated card sent with a greeting or personal message.
One of a set of small rectangles used in games.

ex.en: I tapped my card to pay for the groceries.
Providing every student with a library card encourages independent reading and improves access to educational resources.

col: an identity card｜giấy tờ tùy thân
tip: play cards là chơi bài, cards ở số nhiều và không có mạo từ phía trước.

senses.en: feeling fear or worry about something
used to introduce unwelcome information politely

ex.en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
Some employees are afraid to report workplace problems because they worry about losing their jobs.

col: afraid to ask｜ngại không dám hỏi
afraid of making mistakes｜sợ mắc lỗi
tip: Thường làm vị ngữ, không đặt trước danh từ; dùng afraid of hoặc afraid to do.

senses.en: To begin doing something or cause something to begin.
To make a machine operate, or begin operating.

senses.zh: sự bắt đầu; điểm xuất phát
senses.en: The moment or place where something begins.

ex.en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.

col: at the start of｜vào lúc bắt đầu
make a fresh start｜bắt đầu lại
tip: start doing và start to do thường đều có nghĩa bắt đầu làm gì.

senses.en: A place where ill or injured people receive medical treatment.

ex.en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
Building a new hospital in the region would improve access to specialist care for rural communities.

col: be admitted to hospital｜nhập viện điều trị
tip: Nằm viện: tiếng Anh-Anh in hospital, tiếng Anh-Mỹ in the hospital.

senses.en: the experiences and activities of being alive
the state of being alive

senses.zh: tuổi thọ; thời gian sử dụng
senses.en: the period during which someone lives or something works

ex.en: Life feels quieter since we moved to the countryside.
Access to affordable housing can significantly improve the quality of life in large cities.

col: quality of life｜chất lượng cuộc sống
tip: Số nhiều là lives; nói chung về cuộc sống thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: The middle point or area of something.

senses.zh: trung tâm hoạt động; cơ sở dịch vụ
senses.en: A place providing particular activities, services, or facilities.

senses.zh: lấy làm trung tâm; tập trung vào
senses.en: Make something the main focus of attention or activity.

ex.en: We placed a vase in the centre of the table.
A new community centre could provide affordable exercise facilities and meeting spaces for local residents.

tip: centre là cách viết Anh-Anh, Anh-Mỹ viết center; động từ thường đi với on.

senses.en: A regularly published collection of articles and pictures.

ex.en: She bought a gardening magazine at the station.
A specialist magazine can provide practical career advice that general news websites may not offer.

tip: Danh từ đếm được; tiếng Anh-Anh thường nhấn âm cuối, tiếng Anh-Mỹ nhấn âm đầu.

senses.en: Do something repeatedly to improve your skill
Work in a profession such as medicine or law
Regularly follow a belief, custom, or method

ex.en: I practise the violin quietly after dinner each evening.
Language learners should practise speaking regularly rather than rely entirely on memorising vocabulary and grammar rules.

col: practise what you preach｜sống đúng theo điều mình tin
tip: Tiếng Anh-Anh: động từ practise, danh từ practice; tiếng Anh-Mỹ dùng practice cho cả hai.

senses.en: A large town where many people live and work.

ex.en: We explored the city on foot all afternoon.
A well-designed city provides accessible public transport and green spaces that improve residents' quality of life.

tip: Số nhiều là cities; trung tâm thành phố trong tiếng Anh-Anh dùng city centre.

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.

ex.en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
Students may find repetitive exercises boring unless teachers explain their purpose and introduce variety.

col: find something boring｜thấy việc gì đó chán
tip: boring miêu tả điều gây chán; bored miêu tả người cảm thấy chán.

senses.zh: hoàn thành; kết thúc; ăn xong
senses.en: to complete something or reach its end
the final part or end of something

senses.zh: lớp hoàn thiện bề mặt; độ bóng
senses.en: the appearance or texture of a completed surface

ex.en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
Students who finish their assignments early have more time to review feedback and improve their understanding.

col: finish doing something｜làm xong việc gì
finish an assignment｜hoàn thành bài tập
a smooth finish｜bề mặt nhẵn mịn
tip: Làm xong việc gì dùng finish doing, không dùng finish to do.

senses.en: A farm animal with a broad snout and short legs.

ex.en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.

tip: pig chỉ con vật; thịt lợn làm thức ăn thường dùng pork.

senses.zh: của chúng ta; của chúng tôi
senses.en: Belonging to or connected with the speaker and other people.

ex.en: Our kitchen smells wonderful when Dad bakes fresh bread.
Investing in public transport could improve our quality of life and reduce urban air pollution.

col: our daily lives｜cuộc sống hằng ngày của chúng ta
our local community｜cộng đồng nơi chúng ta sống
our shared future｜tương lai chung của chúng ta
tip: our phải đi kèm danh từ; ours có thể đứng độc lập.

senses.en: a game where teams kick a ball into opposing goals
an American game involving carrying, throwing, and kicking an oval ball

ex.en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.

col: football club｜câu lạc bộ bóng đá
tip: Trong tiếng Anh-Anh, football là bóng đá; trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ thường chỉ bóng bầu dục kiểu Mỹ.

senses.en: A place where trains or buses stop for passengers.
A place or organisation providing a particular service.
To place someone somewhere to perform a duty.

ex.en: We hurried to the station with our heavy suitcases.
Local authorities should station trained staff at busy transport hubs to assist passengers with limited mobility.

col: be stationed at｜được bố trí ở
tip: Khi là động từ thường dùng bị động be stationed at, nghĩa là được bố trí đóng ở.

senses.en: On the day after today.
The day after today, or the future more generally.

ex.en: We are meeting at the swimming pool tomorrow morning.
The environmental decisions made today will shape the world that the children of tomorrow inherit.

tip: Trước tomorrow thường không dùng on; sáng mai là tomorrow morning.

senses.en: coming immediately after the third in a sequence
one of four equal parts of a whole

ex.en: Our apartment is on the fourth floor, beside the lift.
The fourth stage of the recycling process involves transforming cleaned plastic into material suitable for new products.

col: a fourth of｜một phần tư của
tip: Thứ tư là fourth; forth nghĩa là tiến về phía trước, cẩn thận chính tả.

senses.en: on this day, or during the present period
the current day or the present period

ex.en: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
Today, many universities offer flexible courses that allow students to combine employment with further education.

col: earlier today｜sớm hơn trong ngày hôm nay
tip: today vừa chỉ hôm nay vừa chỉ thời nay nói chung; phía trước không dùng on.

senses.en: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine
a flat surface extending in every direction
to make wood smooth using a special cutting tool

ex.en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.

col: plane a door｜bào phẳng cánh cửa
tip: by plane không có mạo từ; on a plane cần có mạo từ.

senses.zh: công việc; vị trí việc làm
senses.en: paid work that someone does regularly
a particular task or piece of work

ex.en: My sister found a job at the local library.
Access to practical training can help young people secure a job in a competitive labour market.

col: a full-time job｜công việc toàn thời gian
job satisfaction｜mức độ hài lòng trong công việc
do a good job｜làm rất tốt
tip: job chỉ một công việc cụ thể, đếm được; work chỉ công việc nói chung, thường không đếm được.

senses.en: a large shop selling food and other everyday goods

ex.en: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.

col: supermarket checkout｜quầy thu ngân siêu thị
tip: Mua sắm ở siêu thị thường nói shop at a supermarket.

senses.en: A room where food is prepared and cooked

ex.en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
Shared kitchen facilities can encourage social interaction among students living in university accommodation away from home.

tip: in the kitchen là ở trong bếp; ch đọc là /tʃ/.

senses.en: At what time.
At the time that something happens.
Considering that something is true.

ex.en: When does the next bus leave for town?
When cities invest in reliable public transport, residents are more likely to leave their cars at home.

tip: Trong mệnh đề thời gian chỉ tương lai, sau when thường dùng thì hiện tại đơn.

senses.zh: hướng bắc; phía bắc; miền bắc
senses.en: the direction opposite south, or an area's northern part
in the north or facing towards it

senses.zh: về phía bắc; ở phía bắc
senses.en: towards or in the north

ex.en: The north of the island gets snow every winter.
Investment in rail connections could help towns in the north attract businesses and create more local jobs.

col: further north｜xa hơn về phía bắc
tip: in the north of chỉ phần phía bắc bên trong; north of chỉ nơi nằm ở phía bắc của một nơi khác.

senses.en: A sweet substance used to make food and drinks sweeter

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.

tip: Chỉ đường nói chung thì không đếm được; a spoonful of sugar là một thìa đường.

senses.en: a married man considered in relation to his spouse

senses.zh: tiết kiệm; sử dụng dè sẻn
senses.en: to use resources carefully so they last longer

ex.en: Her husband brought her lunch during a busy shift.
When husbands share household responsibilities equally, both partners have more opportunities to pursue their careers.

col: husband resources｜sử dụng tiết kiệm tài nguyên
tip: Khi là động từ thì mang tính trang trọng, nghĩa là tiết kiệm tài nguyên.

senses.en: free from mistakes and matching the facts
to identify mistakes or change something to make it right
suitable or accepted as proper for a particular situation

ex.en: You were correct about the keys being under the sofa.
Teachers should help students correct their mistakes rather than simply provide them with the right answers.

tip: Vừa là tính từ vừa là động từ; correctly mới là trạng từ.

senses.en: a living creature that feeds on plants or other creatures
relating to animals rather than plants

ex.en: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
Protecting animal habitats is essential because biodiversity supports stable ecosystems and benefits human wellbeing.

col: animal behaviour｜hành vi của động vật
animal habitat｜môi trường sống của động vật
tip: animal không chỉ gồm động vật có vú; chim, cá và côn trùng cũng là động vật.

senses.en: feeling that you need or want a drink
having a strong desire for something

ex.en: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
Children who are thirsty for knowledge benefit from lessons that encourage questions and independent exploration.

col: thirsty for knowledge｜khao khát tri thức
make someone thirsty｜làm ai khát nước
tip: Khao khát cái gì dùng thirsty for, không dùng thirsty of.

senses.en: A tool that uses ink to write or draw.
A small enclosed area where animals are kept.
To write a letter, story or other piece of writing.

ex.en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
Some students prefer using a pen because writing by hand helps them organise their ideas.

col: pen a letter｜viết một bức thư
tip: pen chỉ các loại bút mực nói chung; bút máy có thể nói rõ là fountain pen.

senses.en: To go away from a person or place.
To let something remain somewhere, deliberately or accidentally.
An officially allowed period away from work.

ex.en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
Paid parental leave allows new parents to care for their children without immediately returning to work.

col: leave a message｜để lại lời nhắn
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ của leave đều là left.

senses.en: An opening with glass that lets light into a building
An area on a screen displaying a program or document

senses.zh: cơ hội ngắn ngủi; khoảng thời gian thuận lợi
senses.en: A limited period when something can be done

ex.en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.

col: a window of opportunity｜cơ hội ngắn ngủi
tip: Cửa sổ trên máy tính cũng là window; window of opportunity nhấn mạnh thời cơ có hạn.

senses.en: To travel on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle.
A journey on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle.

ex.en: We ride our bikes to the lake every weekend.
Safer cycling routes could encourage more residents to ride bicycles rather than drive for short urban journeys.

col: go for a ride｜đi dạo bằng xe
give someone a ride｜cho ai đi nhờ
tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: ride, rode, ridden.

senses.en: a body part used for standing and walking
a support beneath a table, chair, or similar object
one stage of a journey or race

ex.en: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
Regular walking strengthens the muscles in our legs and can improve health without expensive equipment.

col: stretch your legs｜duỗi chân cho đỡ mỏi
the final leg of a journey｜chặng cuối của hành trình
tip: leg cũng chỉ chân bàn ghế hoặc một chặng của hành trình.

senses.en: a soft, juicy fruit often eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: She sliced a ripe tomato for her cheese sandwich.
Growing tomatoes in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.

tip: Số nhiều là tomatoes; hai cách phát âm Anh-Anh và Anh-Mỹ có nguyên âm nhấn khác nhau.

senses.en: make an effort to do something
use or do something to see whether it works
an attempt to do something

ex.en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
Schools should try different teaching methods to meet the needs of students with varying abilities.

col: try to do something｜cố gắng làm việc gì
try doing something｜thử làm việc gì
give it a try｜thử một lần
tip: try to do nhấn mạnh sự cố gắng; try doing nhấn mạnh việc thử một cách làm.

senses.en: A place where people pay to eat prepared meals.

ex.en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
Local restaurants can attract tourists by serving traditional dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms.

col: book a table at a restaurant｜đặt bàn ở nhà hàng
run a restaurant｜điều hành nhà hàng
a seafood restaurant｜nhà hàng hải sản
tip: restaurant là nơi dùng bữa; hotel chủ yếu là nơi lưu trú.

senses.en: a large road vehicle that carries passengers
to transport people somewhere by bus

ex.en: We caught the last bus home after the concert.
More frequent bus services could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in outer suburbs.

col: catch a bus｜kịp chuyến xe buýt
tip: by bus không có mạo từ; take a bus cần có mạo từ.

senses.en: A male parent.
A man who established or greatly influenced a field.

senses.zh: làm cha; là cha đẻ của
senses.en: To become the biological father of a child.

ex.en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.

col: the father of modern medicine｜cha đẻ của y học hiện đại
tip: father trang trọng hơn, dad mang tính khẩu ngữ hơn; Ngày của Cha là Father's Day.

senses.en: the body part below the ankle used for standing and walking
a unit of length equal to twelve inches
the lowest part of something tall or sloping

ex.en: A tiny stone in my shoe hurt my foot.
Making essential services accessible on foot can encourage physical activity and reduce dependence on private cars.

col: at the foot of｜ở chân (núi, cầu thang...)
tip: Số nhiều của bàn chân và đơn vị foot đều là feet; đi bộ dùng on foot.

senses.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.

ex.en: We watched the airplane disappear behind a white cloud.
Travelling by airplane connects remote communities to essential services, although it also contributes to carbon emissions.

tip: airplane thường dùng trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ, tiếng Anh-Anh thường dùng aeroplane.

senses.en: relating to France, its people, or its language
the language spoken in France and several other countries
the people of France, referred to collectively as the French

ex.en: We bought fresh bread from a small French bakery.
Learning French can improve employment prospects in regions where the language is widely used in business.

tip: Luôn viết hoa chữ cái đầu; the French chỉ người Pháp nói chung.

senses.en: used for a male person receiving an action or following a preposition

ex.en: My brother forgot his lunch, so I brought it to him.
When a student struggles with reading, teachers can support him through regular practice and constructive feedback.

col: give him a chance｜cho anh ấy một cơ hội
tip: he làm chủ ngữ, him làm tân ngữ của động từ hoặc giới từ.

senses.zh: chiều; tối (sau 12 giờ trưa, trước nửa đêm)
senses.en: after noon and before midnight, used when stating a time

ex.en: The swimming pool closes at eight p.m. today.
Keeping public libraries open until nine p.m. would allow more working adults to access educational resources.

col: at three p.m.｜lúc ba giờ chiều
until ten p.m.｜cho đến mười giờ tối
tip: Đặt sau giờ; 12 p.m. là buổi trưa, 12 a.m. là nửa đêm.

senses.en: The first part or starting point of something.

ex.en: We missed the beginning of the film yesterday.
The beginning of formal education marks an important stage in a child's social development.

col: at the beginning of｜vào lúc bắt đầu
from beginning to end｜từ đầu đến cuối
a new beginning｜một khởi đầu mới
tip: at the beginning of theo sau là danh từ; in the beginning nghĩa là ban đầu.

senses.en: Covered with dirt or other unwanted substances.
Dishonest or unfair, especially when trying to gain an advantage.
To make something dirty or become dirty.

ex.en: Please leave your dirty boots outside the kitchen door.
Limited access to clean water forces many communities to rely on dirty sources that can spread disease.

tip: So sánh hơn dirtier, so sánh nhất dirtiest.

senses.zh: ngữ pháp; quy tắc ngữ pháp
senses.en: The rules for combining words and changing their forms.

ex.en: Our teacher explains grammar using examples from everyday conversations.
Although grammar instruction is important, language courses should also give learners opportunities to communicate in realistic situations.

col: a grammar exercise｜bài tập ngữ pháp
tip: Khi chỉ kiến thức ngữ pháp thì không đếm được; một lỗi ngữ pháp là a grammar mistake.

senses.en: used before a noun to identify something farther away

senses.zh: cái đó; việc đó; đại từ quan hệ
senses.en: refers to something indicated, or introduces a defining relative clause
introduces a clause expressing a statement, belief, or fact

ex.en: Could you pass me that bowl beside the window?
Research suggests that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.

tip: Khi là từ chỉ định, số nhiều là those; trong mệnh đề tân ngữ that thường có thể lược bỏ.

senses.en: A paper or electronic pass allowing travel or entry.
An official notice requiring payment for a traffic offence.
To give someone an official notice for a traffic offence.

ex.en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
Lower ticket prices could encourage more commuters to choose trains instead of driving to work.

col: parking ticket｜giấy phạt đỗ xe sai quy định
tip: Trong tiếng Anh-Anh, single ticket là vé một chiều, return ticket là vé khứ hồi.

senses.en: Coming after the second and before the fourth.
One of three equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.

col: one third of｜một phần ba của
tip: Phân số: one third; two thirds.

senses.en: The study of quantities, shapes, and relationships using logical rules

ex.en: We used coloured blocks to practise maths after lunch.
Strong maths skills help students interpret financial information and make informed decisions in everyday life.

tip: Tiếng Anh-Anh dùng maths, tiếng Anh-Mỹ dùng math; làm chủ ngữ thì dùng động từ số ít.

senses.en: Coming immediately after the first in an order.
A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.
To formally support a proposal made by someone else.

ex.en: This is my second cup of tea today.
Learning a second language can broaden career opportunities and help students understand perspectives from other cultures.

col: a second chance｜cơ hội thứ hai
second a motion｜tán thành đề nghị
tip: the second là cái thứ hai; a second có thể là một cái nữa.

senses.en: The surface inside a building that people walk on.
A level of a building.
The bottom surface of a sea, valley, or similar area.

ex.en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
Converting unused upper floors into apartments could help cities address housing shortages without expanding outwards.

tip: Tiếng Anh-Anh first floor là tầng hai; tiếng Anh-Mỹ first floor là tầng một.

senses.en: land and buildings used for growing crops or raising animals

senses.zh: làm ruộng; canh tác; chăn nuôi
senses.en: to grow crops or raise animals for food or other products

ex.en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
Small farms can support local food supplies while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.

col: a dairy farm｜trang trại bò sữa
work on a farm｜làm việc ở nông trại
farm animals｜gia súc ở nông trại
farm the land｜canh tác đất đai
tip: Nói ở trang trại thường dùng on a farm, không dùng in.

senses.en: Not high in position, amount, level, or degree.
Feeling sad or lacking confidence.

senses.zh: ở vị trí thấp; nhỏ tiếng
senses.en: At a small height, level, or volume.

ex.en: The low shelf is easy for children to reach.
Low wages can prevent essential workers from finding affordable housing close to their places of employment.

col: run low on｜sắp cạn; còn lại ít
tip: Giá thấp dùng low; đồ rẻ dùng cheap.

senses.en: A picture made using paint.
The activity of creating pictures with paint.
The activity of covering a surface with paint.

ex.en: We hung a colourful painting above the sofa.
Public galleries make important paintings accessible to everyone, regardless of their income or educational background.

tip: Chỉ một bức tranh thì đếm được; chỉ hoạt động vẽ thì không đếm được.

senses.en: A drawing showing where places or features are located

senses.zh: vẽ bản đồ; lập sơ đồ phân bố
senses.en: To draw or record the position of places or features

ex.en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
Researchers use satellite images to map changes in forest cover and identify areas needing urgent protection.

col: map out a route｜lên kế hoạch lộ trình
map changes｜lập sơ đồ sự thay đổi
tip: Khi là động từ, quá khứ mapped, hiện tại phân từ mapping.

senses.en: To change position or go to live somewhere else.
To make someone feel a strong emotion.
An action taken to achieve a particular result.

ex.en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
The decision to expand public transport is a positive move towards reducing urban congestion.

col: move forward｜tiến lên; có tiến triển
be deeply moved｜vô cùng xúc động
a positive move｜biện pháp chủ động
tip: moving là gây xúc động, moved là cảm thấy xúc động.

senses.en: To make something go or be delivered to another place.
To arrange for someone to go somewhere.

ex.en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.

col: send someone to do something｜cử ai đi làm việc gì
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là sent; có thể dùng send sth to sb.

senses.en: the number equal to six times ten

ex.en: My grandfather turned sixty and celebrated with a picnic.
The survey found that sixty percent of respondents preferred reliable buses to additional parking spaces.

col: in your sixties｜ở độ tuổi ngoài sáu mươi
tip: sixty nhấn âm đầu; sixteen thường nhấn âm cuối.

senses.en: Related items or names written one below another.
To write or state items one after another.

ex.en: I made a shopping list before leaving home.
The report lists several practical measures that cities can adopt to reduce traffic congestion.

tip: Có tên trong danh sách dùng on the list, không dùng in.

senses.en: come together with someone, by arrangement or chance
fulfil a need or reach a required standard

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
Public transport services must meet the needs of residents who cannot afford private cars.

col: meet someone for the first time｜gặp ai lần đầu
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là met; meet với yêu cầu nghĩa là đáp ứng.

senses.en: To remain in a place or live somewhere temporarily.
To continue being in a particular condition.

senses.zh: thời gian lưu lại; kỳ lưu trú
senses.en: A period spent living or visiting somewhere.

ex.en: We stayed at a small hotel beside the lake.
Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.

col: stay at a hotel｜ở khách sạn
a short stay｜ở lại một thời gian ngắn
tip: Sau stay có thể thêm tính từ trực tiếp, như stay calm là giữ bình tĩnh.

senses.en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.

ex.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.

tip: Chỉ thức ăn nói chung thì không đếm được; foods chỉ các loại thực phẩm khác nhau.

senses.en: Sounds arranged with rhythm or melody for people to enjoy
Written symbols showing how a piece should be played or sung

ex.en: Soft music drifted through the kitchen while we cooked.
Learning music at school can develop children's creativity and provide opportunities for cooperation through group performances.

col: a piece of music｜một bản nhạc
tip: music không đếm được; một bản nhạc nói a piece of music.

senses.en: An electrical appliance that keeps food and drinks cold.

ex.en: Put the milk back in the fridge, please.
Choosing an energy-efficient fridge can reduce household electricity consumption and lower costs over time.

col: fridge freezer｜tủ lạnh có ngăn đá
tip: fridge là cách nói ngắn gọn thường dùng của refrigerator.

senses.en: A collection of connected web pages available on the internet

ex.en: I found the museum's opening hours on its website.
A well-designed government website can make public services more accessible to people in remote areas.

col: visit a website｜truy cập trang web
launch a website｜đưa trang web lên mạng
tip: Trên trang web dùng on a website; webpage là một trang đơn lẻ.

senses.en: a country in East Asia

ex.en: My cousin returned from China with beautiful mountain photographs.
The expansion of high-speed rail in China illustrates how transport investment can improve connections between major cities.

col: made in China｜sản xuất tại Trung Quốc
tip: China viết hoa là Trung Quốc; china viết thường là đồ sứ; tính từ là Chinese.

senses.en: A device or system for speaking to people far away.
To contact someone or speak to them using a phone.

ex.en: The telephone rang just as I opened the door.
Telephone consultations can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who live far from medical centres.

tip: telephone không chỉ dùng ở Mỹ; trong đời thường hay nói tắt là phone.

senses.en: Something you ask to obtain information or an answer

senses.zh: vấn đề; điều cần giải quyết
senses.en: An issue that needs discussion, consideration, or a decision
To ask someone for information or express doubt about something

ex.en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
Researchers increasingly question whether longer working hours actually improve productivity in modern office environments.

col: answer a question｜trả lời câu hỏi
raise a question｜nêu ra một câu hỏi
question an assumption｜nghi ngờ một giả định
tip: Động từ question có thể đi thẳng với người, nghĩa là hỏi han hoặc thẩm vấn.

senses.en: A small community of homes, usually in the countryside.
The people who live in a village, considered together.

ex.en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.

col: a remote village｜ngôi làng hẻo lánh
tip: the whole village có thể chỉ toàn bộ dân làng, không phải các tòa nhà.

senses.en: information about recent events or something previously unknown

senses.zh: bản tin; chương trình tin tức
senses.en: a broadcast or report presenting recent events

ex.en: She called her sister to share the good news.
People should check several reliable sources before sharing news about health issues on social media.

col: a piece of news｜một mẩu tin
tip: news không đếm được và đi với động từ số ít: The news is good.

senses.en: A unit of language with meaning.
A promise or assurance that someone gives.
To express something using particular language.

ex.en: I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
Students remember new words more effectively when they encounter them repeatedly in meaningful contexts.

col: word a question carefully｜cân nhắc kỹ cách đặt câu hỏi
tip: keep your word là giữ lời, word không dùng số nhiều.

senses.en: having little or no light
having a colour closer to black than white
the absence of light, especially at night

ex.en: The hallway was too dark to find my shoes.
Poorly lit streets can feel dark and unsafe, discouraging residents from walking after sunset.

col: in the dark｜trong bóng tối; không hay biết
tip: dark vừa chỉ thiếu ánh sáng vừa chỉ màu đậm; bóng tối thường dùng the dark.

senses.en: to notice something using your eyes
to understand something
to meet or visit someone

ex.en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.

col: see a doctor｜đi khám bác sĩ
see the difference｜nhận ra sự khác biệt
tip: Quá khứ saw, quá khứ phân từ seen; see nhấn mạnh việc nhìn thấy chứ không phải xem.

senses.en: A round underground vegetable with brown, red, or yellow skin.

ex.en: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
Potato farming provides an important source of food and income for many rural communities worldwide.

tip: Số nhiều là potatoes, thêm es ở cuối.
